title: observation
description: A number about a subject at a moment or over a period: downloads, stars, prices, ranks. See contracts/observation.md.

id.description: lowercase hex sha256 of the word observation, source, subject, metric, the moment or the period's start and end joined by a slash, and value as written, each followed by a newline except the last

subject.description: the id of the subject the number is about

metric.description: the source's own name for the number, such as downloads or stargazers_count

value.description: the number, or the moment, as the source gave it; the metric says which

unit.description: the unit, when the source gives one, such as USD

at.description: the moment the value holds, for a count read at a moment

period.description: the span the value covers, for a count over a span; from is included, to is not

url.description: where the number can be seen, when it has an address

fetched_at.description: when the response it came from was received, read from the kept response

private.description: true when it came from a private stream the owner consented to

raw_ref.description: where the raw response it came from is kept, relative to the store
